GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.

   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel

   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)

   B. Ice melting to water

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
